about_the_game:
The Story

One seemingly ordinary morning, you arrive at school only to discover that all your classmates have vanished without a trace. Determined to rescue them, you follow the clues that lead you to the ominous Tower of Shadows — where your friends are imprisoned, desperately awaiting a hero. The bus of destiny is calling. Step aboard and begin your adventure!

Learn While Playing, Play While Learning

Master essential 2nd–3rd grade math skills through integrated quizzes woven into classic turn-based RPG gameplay. The game encourages children to actively explore knowledge, using spatial memory techniques to enhance learning and retention. Math has never been this exciting or accessible.

Gameplay

Navigate through intricate mazes and climb to the summit of the Tower of Shadows. Wield an arsenal of weapons, items, and power-ups to defeat Slimes, Demon Cats, and other forces of darkness. Conquer fearsome bosses, rescue your friends, and solve math quizzes in the midst of battle. Become the hero of your class — triumph not just through strength, but through wit!
